skill_name: Compare and contrast the industrial revolution and the digital revolution.
workflow: The industrial revolution and the digital revolution were two major shifts in the way goods were produced, consumed and distributed. The industrial revolution led to a shift from manual production to more automated forms of production, while the digital revolution changed the way data was collected, used, and shared.
